build_commit: 532761e2 (deployed); speech model base.en (settings file read back)
setup: The Deck's AI held no model ('ollama ps' empty). deck_launchGame refused four times: its first step (one GUIDE press to open the Steam main menu) did not open the menu each time (MainMenu page stayed hidden, width 2). I tried the same press by hand three more times (80, 150, 400 ms hold) with the same result, then used the thumb route that the launcher would have used after the menu: the ring was already on the Recent Games tile 'Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor' (Home screen), A on the tile, read focus = 'Play', A on Play. Game started 17:30:23 (RunningApps showed it, process 'DRG Survivor.exe', 48 s later title screen). Then A through the game menus (save 3, Play, Main Missions, Elimination, Sector 01, biome, Engineer, class mod, Hazard 1) into a run. The run showed live play at 17:33:31 (55 fps, enemies and turrets on screen). By the time of the dictation the run was on a 'LEVEL UP' choice screen (screenshot 17:34:04), which pauses the action but the game kept drawing at 60 fps and using the CPU (DRG at 156 to 200 percent CPU in ps/top). So the dictation was done with the game running on a pause-menu inside a run, which is weaker than live shooting. Say so when reading.
pressed: Quick Access opened with deck_openPlugin (opened blind over the game, chord sent first, ring landed on the question box); DOWN x1 (Ask, not pressed), LEFT x1 to Voice input, focus read = Voice input, A as its own step. Stop = A on 'Stop voice input' after focus read.
